name: Odd Squad
description: Odd Squad saves the day whenever something unusual happens.

videos.title: Zero Effect / Bad Luck Bears
videos.overview:
Olive and Otto must stop zeroes from disappearing before the missing zeroes destroy the town… and Otto turns into a baby.

When odd things start happening to the Bears basketball team, Olive and Otto must set things straight before the big game.

videos.title: Soundcheck / Double Trouble
videos.overview: Olive and Otto must figure out how and why things are disappearing around town when all Otto wants to do is listen to a song by his favorite band, Soundcheck.  Debbie from Debbie's Pizzeria has doubled... not once, but twice... creating four Debbies! When one of the Debbies go missing, Olive and Otto need to find her.

videos.title: My Better Half / The Confalones
videos.overview:
When symmetrical objects become vandalized, Olive and Otto must figure out why.

Olive and Otto are called in to help when objects and, eventually, people start disappearing inside an Italian restaurant.

videos.title: Blob on the Job / Party of 5,4,3,2,1
videos.overview:
When a blob gets loose in Odd Squad headquarters, Olive and Otto compete against rival agents to catch it first.

When people in town can no longer count down, Olive and Otto must uncover who is causing the problem and why.

videos.title: Reindeer Games
videos.overview: In this Christmas-themed episode, Olive and Otto help Santa track down his reindeer when they are accidentally shrunk. Also, Oscar helps Ms. O get off Santa's naughty list by making sure the number of nice things she has done is greater than the number of naughty.

videos.title: Oscar and the Oscarbots / Picture Day
videos.overview:
When several of Oscar’s Oscarbots (robots made in his own image) become lost in town, Olive and Otto must help him find them.

Otto and Olive must figure out why people in town are becoming plaid and striped.

videos.title: A Case of the Sing-Alongs / Ms. O Uh-Oh
videos.overview:
When Mayor Macklemore catches a case of the Sing-A-Longs, Olive and Otto must discover the cause before the Mayor sings his way out of his job.

When a Ms. O from the past shows up at the office, Otto and Oscar must send her back to the day she came from or risk causing a time catastrophe.

videos.title: Crime at Shapely Manor
videos.overview: Olive and Otto are sent to Shapely Manor to investigate an odd crime with even odder people.

videos.title: Skip Day / The Great Grinaldi
videos.overview:
When Olive catches a case of The Skips and goes missing, rookie agent Otto must solve his first case by himself.

Otto rushes to finish a case so he can see his favorite magician, The Great Grinaldi, perform.

videos.title: The Trouble with Centigurps / Totally Odd Squad
videos.overview:
When Otto accidentally releases 100 small furry creatures in headquarters, he recruits Oscar to help get them back before Ms. O finds out.

In a flashback episode, Ms. O tells the story of how she defeated a villain called the Patternista back when she was an agent.

videos.title: How to Interrogate a Unicorn / The Briefcase
videos.overview:
When characters escape their books in the library, Olive and Otto must figure out how and why it’s happening and put a stop to it.

When Ms. O’s important briefcase is stolen by a shape shifter, Olive and Otto must get it back.

videos.title: Best Seats in the House / Agent Obfusco
videos.overview:
Olive and Otto battle Oren and Olaf for the best chairs at Odd Squad while Ms. O and Oscar run a top secret mission.

Olive and Otto become concerned when they find out their Odd Squad test is being administered by Agent Obfusco - a mysterious agent who speaks only in word problems.

videos.title: Life of O'Brian / Whatever Happened to Agent Oz
videos.overview:
When a miffed O’Brian won’t let Olive access the tubes, she has to solve the mystery of what she did to upset him.

Olive tells Otto the story of what happened to Octavia's partner, Agent Oz.

videos.title: The Jackies / Invasion of the Body Switchers
videos.overview:
Ms. O and her team will stop at nothing to win their very first Jackie Award.

When Ms. O and Oscar accidentally switch bodies, Olive and Otto must set things right before the entire Odd Squad team finds out what happened.

videos.title: The Odd Antidote / The One That Got Away
videos.overview:
When Ms. O has bizarre side effects after being sprayed by a weird plant, Olive and Otto must travel around town finding the correct measurements of the ingredients for the medicine to cure her, all while keeping Ms. O's condition a secret from her.

The only thing that can bring Ms. O’s old partner O’Donahue out of retirement is the very thing that put him there in the first place: a mysterious villain and a case that’s gone unsolved for years.

videos.title: Odd Outbreak / The Perfect Lunch
videos.overview:
Dr. O takes the lead on the case of a strange medical crisis that causes chaos right in the middle of Odd Squad HQ.

Olive and Otto help Ms. O host a lunch for some very important but easily offended guests.

videos.title: Rise of the Hydraclops / O is Not for Old
videos.overview:
In order to save humanity, Olive and Otto must locate a treasure chest that Oscar buried.

The agents throw a surprise party for Ms. O.

videos.title: Dance Like Nobody's Watching / Recipe for Disaster
videos.overview:
When the alarm system at Headquarters is triggered, Olive, Otto, Ms. O, and Oscar must avoid a series of booby traps in order to shut it off.

Olive and Otto explain to Ms. O how a case went wrong, each in their own way.

videos.title: Hold the Door / Flatastrophe
videos.overview:
When a young agent in training gets lost in headquarters, Olive and Otto must find him before Ms. O finds out.

Olive and Otto must stop Fladam, a villain with a vendetta against cubes.

videos.title: Puppet Show / Mystic Egg Pizza
videos.overview:
Olive and Otto have to crack a case in which a group of people have been turned into puppets.

With the help of Odd Squad, Delivery Debbie and Delivery Doug must figure out why their food is disappearing.

videos.title: 6:00 to 6:05
videos.overview: In this half-hour episode, dinosaurs break out of the dinosaur room in headquarters and Olive and Otto must travel back in time to save the day.

videos.title: The Potato Ultimato / A Fistful of Fruit Juice
videos.overview:
When Otto starts shrinking, Olaf leads Olive and Oren on a quest for the only known cure - the magical Growing Potato.

Ms. O tells Olive and Otto the story of how she first joined up with Odd Squad.

videos.title: Soundcheck Part Deux / Jinx
videos.overview:
When the members of Soundcheck go missing, Otto and Olive must bring them back together in time for their big concert.

When all of Odd Squad comes down with a case of the jinx, it’s up to Oscar and Dr. O to save the day.

videos.title: Training Day
videos.overview: In this half-hour episode, Olive tells the story of what happened to her old partner.

videos.title: Trading Places / Bad Lemonade
videos.overview:
A villain uses one of Oscar’s gadgets to cause destruction around town, which eventually leads to Olive getting kicked off the squad.

Olive and Otto are called in to help when Polly Graph mysteriously quits her lemonade stand.

videos.title: Robert Plant / Game Time
videos.overview:
Olive and Otto must find a way to stop Obfusco’s plant from taking over headquarters.

When Otto gets trapped inside a video game it's up to Olive to rescue him.

videos.title: O Games
videos.overview: In this half-hour episode, Odd Squad agents compete in Olympic style games to determine who gets to be Ms. O for the day.

videos.title: Captain Fun / Switch Your Partner Round and Round
videos.overview:
Otto and Oren compete for votes to become Captain Fun.

Olive and Otto discover what life would have been like if Ms. O had assigned them different partners.

videos.title: Trials and Tubulations
videos.overview: In this half-hour episode, the tube system breaks and Olive and Otto are left stranded in a dangerous forest.

videos.title: The Curious Case of Pirate-itis / Oscar the Couch
videos.overview:
Otto and Oscar try to stop Olive from turning into a pirate.

Oscar accidentally turns himself into a couch.

videos.title: No Ifs, Ands, or Robots / Worst First Day Ever
videos.overview:
Chaos ensues when one of Oscar’s Oscarbots malfunctions.

When Agent Ori’s first day on the job turns into a worst-case scenario, other Odd Squad agents share their own ‘worst first day ever’ stories.

videos.title: Undercover Olive
videos.overview: In this half-hour episode, Olive goes undercover in a high-stakes “Rock, Paper, Scissors” game.

videos.title: Not So Splash / By the Book
videos.overview:
In the middle of summer, Olive and Otto must figure out why parts of the town are turning snowy and cold.

Olive and Otto interrogate two suspects to figure out which one is innocent and which one is guilty.

videos.title: O vs. The Ballcano / Assistants' Creed
videos.overview:
When the ball pit starts to overflow, Odd Squad must stop headquarters from being destroyed.

Two of Ms. O's assistants accidentally find themselves on a mission.

videos.title: Now You Don't See Me / Moustache Confidential
videos.overview:
Olive and Otto must stop a villain who has turned townspeople and Odd Squad agents invisible.

When Agent Obfusco’s moustache is stolen, it’s up to Olive and Otto to get it back.

videos.title: Disorder in the Court
videos.overview: In this half-hour episode, Olive is put on trial for causing oddness.

videos.title: Oscar of All Trades / Swamps 'N' Gators
videos.overview:
Oscar tells Olive about his early days at Odd Squad.

Olive and Otto get trapped inside a board game.

videos.title: There Might Be Dragons / Dawn of the Read
videos.overview:
When the power goes out in headquarters, Odd Squad must figure out a way to control the temperature of dragon eggs.

Odd Squad takes on a page-turner of a case at the local library, where books are mysteriously coming to life.

videos.title: Olive and Otto in Shmumberland
videos.overview: When Olive and Otto get zapped into a comic book, Olive must use her knowledge of the comic book to escape.

videos.title: O is Not For Over
videos.overview: Olive and Otto face their biggest challenge yet.

videos.title: First Day
videos.overview: In this two-part episode, agents struggle with a case while Oscar interviews candidates to run the Odd Squad Creature Room.

videos.title: Back to the Past / Odd Squad Needs You
videos.overview:
Olympia, Otis, Oscar and Oona are accidentally transported to the future.

Otis is asked to make a recruitment commercial for Odd Squad, however Ms. O proves to be difficult to work with.

videos.title: Mid-Day in the Garden of Good and Odd / Failure to Lunch
videos.overview:
When things in town get covered in jam, the agents turn to Odd Todd for help.

When the agents go to lunch, they struggle to relax and ignore the oddness.

videos.title: The O Team / Show Me the Money
videos.overview:
Security agents Owen and Ohio secretly provide backup on a case so they can have a pizza party.

An unlucky coin is accidentally released to the public.

videos.title: Flawed Squad / The Creature Whisperer
videos.overview:
A motley crew of villains storm into Odd Squad headquarters, but can't agree on a plan of attack.

When a creature gets loose in headquarters, Oscar helps Ocean track it down, while Olympia and Otis try to keep Ms. O distracted.

videos.title: Oscar Strikes Back
videos.overview: Oscar takes some time off so he can attend Lab-Con--for the first time. However, someone is controlling the minds of all of the convention attendants except for Oscar, Miss O and Oona. No one's going to ruin Oscar's first Lab-Con. It's time that "Oscar Strikes Back".

videos.title: Olympia's Day / Otis's Day
videos.overview:
When a new room opens up in headquarters, all the agents want a piece.

Getting a villain back to headquarters proves cumbersome when the tubes are down for maintenance.

videos.title: And Then They Were Puppies / A Case of the Sillies
videos.overview:
When every agent turns into a puppy, it's up to Agent Ohlm to save the day.

Dr. O gets an odd illness called the Sillies.

videos.title: Happy Halfiversary / Good Egg Bad Egg
videos.overview:
Otis discovers he's forgotten an important event in his partnership with Olympia. Now, with Oona and Ms. O providing assistance, he sets off on an odd adventure to set things right.

The agents try to determine what kind of creature will hatch from an egg.

videos.title: Night Shift / Put Me in Coach
videos.overview:
Olympia and Otis work the Odd Squad Night Shift and find out that at night the squad works very differently.

When Ms. O accidentally assigns Olympia and Otis and a rival duo to the same coveted case she sends them all to Coach O, who sets up a competition between the teams to resolve who gets the case.

videos.title: Extreme Cakeover / A Job Well Undone
videos.overview:
Otis and Olympia accidently release a virus that turns agents into cakes.

Otis has to race to fill out his paperwork so he and Olympia can earn "employee of the month".

videos.title: Three's Company / Behind Enemy Mimes
videos.overview:
When Ms. O's office must be repaired due to odd infestations, she cramps Olympia and Otis's style.

Ms. O needs Otis and Olympia's help to track down her old partner O'Donahue.

videos.title: Drop Gadget Repeat / 20 Questions
videos.overview:
Oona, Olympia and Otis try to escape from a time loop.

A villain sets off a backwards bubble that causes everyone at headquarters to move backwards.

videos.title: High Maintenance / Not OK Computer
videos.overview:
Otis and Olympia accept a challenge to switch jobs with the maintenance department for a day.

When Olympia and Otis get trapped in their computer, it's up to the Odd Squad Computer Department to rescue them.

videos.title: O is for Opposite / Agent Oksana's Kitchen Nightmares
videos.overview:
When Ms. O gets trapped in a mirror, an opposite Ms. O enters the real world.

The agents try to resolve a disagreement between Ms. O and Oksana.

videos.title: Rookie Night / Who Let the Doug Out
videos.overview:
It's party time for all the new agents at Odd Squad.

Delivery Doug needs help with an egg situation.

videos.title: The Cherry-On-Top-Inator / Sir
videos.overview:
Agents recall how a beloved gadget helped them.

The agents bring someone with an odd problem back to headquarters.

videos.title: Orchid's Almost Half Hour Talent Show / The Perfect Score
videos.overview:
All the agents want to be a part of Orchid's talent show.

It's villain report card day at Odd Squad.

videos.title: The Voice / Partner Problems
videos.overview:
A villain steals Ms. O's voice.

The agents are called in to help when Ohlm and Orchid have problems working together.

videos.title: Oona and the Oonabots / The Ninja Situation
videos.overview:
Oona uses her Oonabots to fix an odd problem.

Odd Squad must go undercover to recover a stolen gadget.

videos.title: Breakfast Club / Dr. O: Party Time, Excellent
videos.overview:
Delivery Debbie goes undercover to stop a group of villains.

When Olympia finds out Dr. O is leaving, she struggles to throw the best goodbye party ever.

videos.title: Haunt Squad / Safe House in the Woods
videos.overview:
Odd Squad is haunted by a ghost.

Owen and new recruit Ozlyn wait out a storm while transporting a creature.

videos.title: Xs and Os / Dr. O No
videos.overview:
A special task squad may close HQ.

Dr. O's replacement struggles to help patients who suffer from a bizarre ailment.

videos.title: Negative Town / License to Science
videos.overview:
The agents go to Negative Town to track a villain.

Oona must pass her lab director's test or risk getting kicked off Odd Squad.

videos.title: Two Agents and a Baby / Ocean and the Fly
videos.overview:
Olympia and Otis are forced to babysit Baby Genius.

Oona accidentally switched bodies with a fly.

videos.title: Hands on a Desk Chair / There Is No O in O-Bot
videos.overview:
When Ms. O leaves to conduct a super-secret mission, the agents compete to figure out who is in charge.

Otis and Olympia are stuck with a new robot partner.

videos.title: Shapely University / Slow Day
videos.overview: Agents compete against rival Odd Squad agents to solve an odd problem.  Otis and Olympia investigate why people in town are stuck in slow motion.

videos.title: Villains In Need Are Villains Indeed / Happily Ever Odd
videos.overview:
Odd Squad and Villains work together to stop a giant robot.

The agents accidentally lose someone in headquarters.

videos.title: Where There's a Wolf, There's a Way / New Jacket Required
videos.overview:
Otis and Olympia stop werewolf Olaf from turning back into a boy.

Otis struggles with his new high-tech agent's jacket.

videos.title: Deposit Slip-Up / Villains Always Win
videos.overview:
Odd Squad builds an exact replica of the villain's vault to intercept a jetpack.

Olympia tries to win back a stolen gadget on a villain game show.

videos.title: Other Olympia / Total Zeroes
videos.overview: Other Olympia - Olympia squares off with another Agent named Olympia. Total Zeros - Ms. O tells Olympia and Otis an old story about a villain duo with the power of zero.

videos.title: It Takes Goo to Make a Feud Go Right / Friends of Odd Squad
videos.overview: It Takes Goo to Make a Feud Go Right: Olympia and Otis are tasked with calling a truce between feuding guests. Friends of Odd Squad: Ms. O leaves headquarters in the hands of an unlikely crew.

videos.title: Saving Agent Orson / The Scientist
videos.overview:
The agents try and stop baby Agent Orson from getting kicked off the squad.

Oona gets zapped to an alternate dimension.

videos.title: Who Is Agent Otis?
videos.overview: Olympia uncovers a secret about her partner.

videos.title: Odds and Ends
videos.overview: The agents must come together to battle a common enemy.

videos.title: Odd Beginnings, Part 1
videos.overview: Agent Opal and Agent Omar are tired of their post at the Arctic Odd Squad Headquarters, because nothing odd ever happens there. Luckily, Opal thinks she may have uncovered the location of a legendary Odd Artifact: a 44-leaf clover. The only problem is, villains are also hot on its trail. In the wrong hands, the clover could cause worldwide, catastrophic oddness! With the help of fellow agents, Opal and Omar must find and save the 44-leaf clover before it's too late.  Curriculum: Measurement, Simple Machines

videos.title: Odd Beginnings, Part 2
videos.overview: Agent Opal and Agent Omar are tired of their post at the Arctic Odd Squad Headquarters, because nothing odd ever happens there. Luckily, Opal thinks she may have uncovered the location of a legendary Odd Artifact: a 44-leaf clover. The only problem is, villains are also hot on its trail. In the wrong hands, the clover could cause worldwide, catastrophic oddness! With the help of fellow agents, Opal and Omar must find and save the 44-leaf clover before it's too late.  Curriculum: Measurement, Simple Machines

videos.title: Portalandia / Slides and Ladders
videos.overview:
The Mobile Unit's first case is all the way across the world in Japan. Orla is disappointed when the task is super simple: return a plant to the 17th dimension. All it requires is putting together a build-it-yourself portal. But when Orla rushes through constructing the portal without reading the instructions, Omar, Oswald, and Opal end up stuck in the 17th dimension.

Oswald finally lands an interview on a famous Odd Squad podcast to talk about the new Mobile Unit van. But he is only familiar with the main floor of the van and hasn't yet ventured into any of the other 87 floors, including those below ground level. In his attempt to learn more about the van, Oswald gets lost and risks missing his interview altogether.

videos.title: Running on Empty
videos.overview: On the way to deliver a baby blob to The Big O in London, England, the Mobile Unit van runs out of fuel. The team must refuel quickly and get underway before the baby blob's big brother completely blobs London as it searches for its little brother. Problem is, the van runs on water, and they're stranded in the desert.  Curriculum: Liquid Measurement, Porous vs. Non-Porous

videos.title: Orla's Birthday / Jeremy
videos.overview:
Omar has great plans to surprise Orla with a 500th birthday party. But due to some intense Odd Squad history, normal party gifts aren't going to fare well with her. So, while Opal keeps Orla busy with a string of false villain leads, Oswald and Omar must track down the ideal birthday presents.

While solving oddness on a farm, the team meets a kid named Jeremy, who is their biggest fan. Opal really wants to shine in front of him, but the team accidentally gets locked out of their van. While half of the Mobile Unit distracts Jeremy, the other half tries to answer the van's security questions using math in order to get back inside.

videos.title: Raising the Bar / The Thrill of the Face
videos.overview:
When the Mobile Unit gets ranked low on the Odd Squad Magazine progress reports, Opal and Orla kick into competitive mode and try to solve as much oddness as possible. Meanwhile, Omar and Oswald visit the Chief of Graph at the Odd Squad Graphing Headquarters in hope of figuring out a safer solution.

The Mobile Unit gets called back to the Museum of Natural Odd when Oswald's replacement, Ortho, has gone radio silent. But when they arrive and find out an ancient stone warrior has been let loose, they must de-code Ortho's strange numbering system to capture the stone warrior and save the museum.

videos.title: Odd Squad in the Shadows
videos.overview: The Mobile Unit is called to Pinehurst, North Carolina to stop a villain who is stealing various objects. If they don't catch the villain in time, the local Odd Squad will be forced to cancel their annual mini golf tournament. But the Mobile Unit is having trouble figuring out who the villain is, because they don't know what the stolen objects share in common.

videos.title: Overdue! / Train of Thoughts
videos.overview:
Orla is kicked off the squad when a library book she took out 400 years ago is overdue. The Mobile Unit must use budgeting to turn their $1 into $10 to pay the late fee, or else Orla will not get her badge back.

There's a villain turning train cars odd, and the Mobile Unit must figure out the pattern in which the villain is striking. Oswald takes it upon himself to solve the train mystery just like his favorite book character: Detective Shmumbers.

videos.title: The Void / Into the Odd Woods
videos.overview:
The Mobile Unit is called to investigate an odd tunnel that some (but not all) agents have disappeared into. When Omar insists they drive the van through the tunnel, he ends up stuck in a white void all alone. By collecting and comparing data, Omar must figure how to escape.

When Omar catches a case of Clown-i-tosis, Orla must keep track of him in the van before he runs off to join the circus.

videos.title: Slow Your Roll
videos.overview: When the mysterious masked villain, "The Shadow",  takes over the Mobile Unit van's computer, the team must act fast to regain control of the van before it drives into The Lake of Goo. While Opal attempts to get to the van's main computer room to re-boot it, the others learn about different types of friction and how they can help slow down a moving object (in this case, the van).

videos.title: The Music of Sound
videos.overview: When Orla is accidentally responsible for breaking up the band Soundcheck, the Mobile Unit team must use Venn diagrams in order to convince the band members that they have things in common and reunite. On top of that, the Mobile Unit must make sure a villainous rival band doesn't hypnotize people with their music. To do that, they have to learn how sound works.

videos.title: Odd in 60 Seconds / Villain Networking
videos.overview:
The Mobile Unit is called to Odd Squad's Top-Secret Security Facility where an unknown villain has broken in to get to the mega-computer. But when Lady Bread, Wheelie Dan, and the Utensiler all claim to be the villain responsible, the team must recreate the break-in to discover the true culprit.

"The Shadow" hosts a meeting of villains worldwide in order to convince them to join her Villain Network. But when she shows them their decline in villainy on a line graph, it catapults the villains into a game of blame. She must come up with a line graph that will convince them all to join, or her master plan will fail.

videos.title: Mr. Unpredictable / Down The Tubes
videos.overview:
A new villain named Mr. Unpredictable calls out the Mobile Unit to try and solve his pattern, which he claims is actually not a pattern at all! Opal can't believe a villain can work without a pattern, but when the team keeps being blindsided, she starts to question herself. Meanwhile, the others take a tour of Villain University to see if they can gather any information about one of its alumni, who just happens to be Mr. Unpredictable.

When the tube system is shut down due to a scrambler installed by a villain, the Mobile Unit van becomes a taxi service for other Odd Squad agents. Once they realize their service will be rated on a scale up to 10 stars, Omar and Opal dedicate themselves to giving the coolest van experience. Meanwhile, Orla rides the tubes for the first time as she and Oswald attempt to figure out where the wires are getting crossed.

videos.title: Sample of New York / It's Not Easy Being Chill
videos.overview:
The Mobile Unit is sent to New York City to fill in for the local Odd Squad agents, who are on strike because they don't like what's being served for lunch. It's up to Opal and Oswald to figure out what they would like to eat. Meanwhile, Orla and Omar must venture out into the city to solve oddness, and see the sights along the way.

Agent-in-training Orpita decides to do her agent profile report on Omar, who is on creature duty, while the rest of the Mobile Unit goes out to defeat a giant robot. But when Orpita turns out to be too laidback, Omar must use fractions to feed the creature properly before it grows too big and escapes.

videos.title: The Sandwich Project / Wax On Wax Odd
videos.overview:
When the members of the Mobile Unit get zapped into sandwiches by the villain, Shelly Catessan, The Big O comes to the rescue. As she combs through video footage taken by Omar to celebrate their 100th case, The Big O must use clues she sees in the videos to figure out the order in which the agents were zapped so she can return them to their agent form.

Curriculum: Time - Order of Events

The Mobile Unit faces a series of challenges that Orla knew was coming from overhearing a sorcerer's conversation 450 years ago. Through flashbacks, Orla shows the rest of the team the times she prepared each of them-unbeknownst to them-for the upcoming challenges.  Curriculum: Calendar

videos.title: Teach a Man to Ice Fish
videos.overview:
When the villain, Confetti Betty, strikes the Odd Squad headquarters in the Arctic, the Mobile Unit returns to help Opal and Omar's old squad. As they attempt to crack the villain's pattern, they must teach the Arctic agents how to solve cases for themselves so that they don't keep getting called back to help.

Curriculum: Addition Patterns, Force and Friction

videos.title: The Weight of the World Depends on Orla / Substitute Agents
videos.overview:
Orla shares the story of how she was chosen to protect the 44-leaf clover in order to stop the villain, Jellybean Joe, from causing oddness to the Mobile Unit van.

Curriculum: Measurement - Weight / Density

When Odd Squad maintenance and kitchen workers Oxley and Olanda discover the Mobile Unit has been trapped in a snow globe by the villain, Sue Venir, they try their hands at being agents, setting out to stop Sue and save the team. This unlikely duo uses prediction and probability to figure out where the villain will most likely strike next in order to stop her.  Curriculum: Prediction and Probability

videos.title: Oswald in the Machine / The B-Team
videos.overview:
An Odd Squad gadget has been stolen and is being kept in a warehouse run by robots, forcing Oswald to go undercover as a robot to get it back. Since the gadget is being stored in a room only accessible by actual robots, the team must take control of a robot and use coding to program it to retrieve the stolen gadget.

Curriculum: Coding

The Mobile Unit learns how things might have been if they hadn't joined the team by using "What-Would-It-Have-Been-Like-Inator" helmets.

Curriculum: Addition and Doubling

videos.title: 16-and-a-Half Blocks / Follow the Leader
videos.overview:
Evil Sculptor approaches the Mobile Unit, because he wants to leave the Villain Network, and offers to give them top-secret villain info. The team must bring him 16-and-a-half blocks away to meet The Big O at a safe house and enter the villain protection program. The problem is, the other villains have caught wind of his defection and won't let him go so easily.  Curriculum: Mapping

Using the tip from Evil Sculptor, the Mobile Unit goes undercover as villains to catch the leader of the Villain Network. But first, they must go through a series of tests to prove they really are villains.

Curriculum: Deductive Reasoning

videos.title: End of the Road
videos.overview:
With the help of The Big O and two Australian agents, the Mobile Unit must head ,Down Under, to stop ,The Shadow, from causing world-wide oddness.

Curriculum: Patterns and Coordinate Mapping

videos.title: Box Trot / O for a Day
Mission O Possible / Nature of the Sandbeast
H2 Oh No / In Your Dreams
Can You Wrangle It? / Ahead of the Times
The Problem with Pentagurps / Three Portals Down
Set Lasers to Profit
videos.overview: Three villains team up with Bonnie Blaster and her high-powered, oddness-causing gadget.

videos.title: Villains Helping Villains
videos.overview: Jamie Jam and Marty Marmalade are always stopped by Odd Squad! Determined to help other villains avoid getting caught, they team up to trade tips.

videos.title: Monumental Oddness
videos.overview: Globetrotting villain Stu Venir is turning monuments into keychains! Agents must uncover a pattern to predict where he will strike next.

videos.title: Party Crashers
videos.overview: It’s Oswald’s birthday! After running into a Party Crasher creature, there are suddenly four of him who seem identical.

videos.title: Why Did the Chicken Cross the Dimension
videos.overview: The Mobile Unit is called upon when a lost Baby Laser Chicken is found in the Austrian countryside.

videos.title: Off the Clock
videos.overview: The Odd Squad Timekeeper keeps time for all of the clocks around the world. When she’s suddenly struck with oddness, the clocks stop working.

videos.title: Sunny Sides Add Up
videos.overview: Orla thought she was the only ancient Agent left. However, when a distress call comes through, it becomes clear that she was wrong.

videos.title: Old Odd, New Tricks
videos.overview: Now that ancient Agent Olando has completed retraining, he is ready to go out into the field with the Mobile Unit.

videos.title: Odd Together Now, Part 1
videos.overview: In this two-part season finale, the Odd Squad Mobile Unit must stop a group of villains who want to break into Odd Squad Headquarters to steal an ancient artifact. Little do the Agents know, their greatest challenge will come from someone inside!

videos.title: Odd Together Now, Part 2
videos.overview: In this two-part season finale, the Odd Squad Mobile Unit must stop a group of villains who want to break into Odd Squad Headquarters to steal an ancient artifact. Little do the Agents know, their greatest challenge will come from someone inside!

videos.title: Odd Off the Press, Part 1
videos.overview: The Odd Squad Mobile Unit has a new member and new challenges.

videos.title: Odd Off the Press, Part  2
videos.overview: The Odd Squad Mobile Unit has a new member and new challenges.

videos.title: Box Trot
videos.overview: The Mobile Unit is on a mission to get rid of a box containing villain powers, but Lady Bread, Star Wipe, and Monsieur Papier Maché have a plan.

videos.title: O for a Day
videos.overview: The Mobile Unit fills in for Seattle Mr O.

videos.title: H2 Oh No!
videos.overview: When villain mastermind William Ocean plans to cover the entire world in water, the Mobile Unit heads to his underwater lair.

videos.title: In Your Dreams
videos.overview: The Mobile Unit must go into Little O’s dreams.

videos.title: Mission O Possible
videos.overview: With Jimmy Jam’s Scrambler Machine scrambling Odd Squad communication, the villains plan to unleash oddness.

videos.title: Nature of the Sandbeast
videos.overview: Dr Dry has stolen the Sandbeast’s golden egg. It will only be a matter of time before the Sandbeast covers the world in sand.

videos.title: Double O Trouble, Part 1
videos.overview: An arts and crafts villain named Aarti Craft has turned all the agents in Chicago into paper dolls! Fortunately, new agents Oxford and Osalind avoided her powers. Now the Mobile Unit must team up with them to stop Aarti for good.

videos.title: Double O Trouble, Part 2
videos.overview: An Arts and Crafts villain named Aarti Craft has turned all the Agents in Chicago into paper dolls! Fortunately, new Agents Oxford and Osalind avoided her powers. Now the Mobile Unit must team up with them to stop Aarti for good.

videos.title: Can You Wrangle It
videos.overview: With The Big O in space, the Xs are checking Agents’ licenses for fighting oddness. Orla and Oswald must get their creature handling licenses, and fast!

videos.title: Ahead of the Times
videos.overview: The Puppy Master plans to turn everyone into puppies, including the Odd Squad Mobile Unit!

videos.title: The Problem with Pentagurps
videos.overview: The Odd Squad mail department is overrun with pentagurps! The Mobile Unit comes in to help before it is shut down.

videos.title: Three Portals Down
videos.overview: With Oswald and Osmerelda feeling under the weather, Orla and Omar work with two back-up Agents to battle oddness on Shmumber Farms.

videos.title: Welcome to the Odd Squad, Part 1
videos.overview: Little O has been asked to record a new training video for kids interested in becoming Odd Squad Agents. However, a Sandbeast is on the loose and causing oddness all over town.

videos.title: Welcome to the Odd Squad, Part 2
videos.overview: Little O has been asked to record a new training video for kids interested in becoming Odd Squad Agents. However, a Sandbeast is on the loose and causing oddness all over town.

videos.title: Odd Ones In, Part 1
videos.overview: With a spike in oddness in the UK, Department of Help agent Ozzie suggests they send for help from the best agent in the world.

videos.title: Odd Ones In, Part 2
videos.overview: With a creature on the loose, and Captain O unable to help, Ozzie and Orli must work together to capture it and save HQ.

videos.title: A Dish Served Odd
videos.overview: When things start turning into delicious puddings, Ozzie and Orli are taken on a tour of the town, which leads them to... a tour of the town.

videos.title: Odd Jubilee
videos.overview: Odd Squad UK is celebrating its jubilee, but the party can’t get started until Orli locates the missing Ozzie, who has a bad case of the Saturdays.

videos.title: The New Ozzie
videos.overview: Ozzie is torn between helping his replacement, Opie, on her first day manning the Odd Squad Department of Help desk, and an important mission with Orli and Onom.

videos.title: Bad Luck-itis
videos.overview: When Ozzie catches bad-luck-itis, Orli and Osgood must go on a magical quest to find the ingredients for the antidote before his increasing bad luck blows apart HQ.

videos.title: The Triangle Sisters
videos.overview: When a museum has square objects stolen and two villains obsessed with triangles are seemingly involved, Orli and Ozzie investigate how the villains can be related to the crime.

videos.title: Miss Information
videos.overview: Villain Miss Information is using graphs to spread falsehoods about Odd Squad, which is leading to the public not trusting them. Can Captain O get the public back on side?

videos.title: A Dicey Situation
videos.overview: Over a board game, Captain O takes Ozzie and Orli back to her time at sea with the case of villain Dottie Dubloon and how she used dice to throw Odd Squad off.

videos.title: Lift Off
videos.overview: Orli has rescued a clam which needs to be returned to its home in the 60th dimension via a portal on the 60th floor. However, to get there, she must negotiate HQ’s odd lift network.

videos.title: A Tour of Odd Squad
videos.overview: Opie leads her first public tour through HQ, but when Orwell discovers one member of the tour group is a villain, they must work out who it is before it’s too late.

videos.title: Club 37
videos.overview: When the exclusive Club 37 opens up in HQ, Orli and Ozzie set out to crack 37 cases so they can enter it. But with more fun clubs opening, will the agents’ club obsession get the better of them?

videos.title: Odd Way Round
videos.overview: Two strange villains team up to stop Orli from making it to her Odd Squad UK exam so that she will fail and be sent back to Niagara Falls.

videos.title: Strictly Odd Dancing
videos.overview: In this musical episode, agents Ostin and Olyla tell the story of their face off against The Music Maestro, and how they learnt to sing and dance to solve cases.

videos.title: Villain of the Year
videos.overview: When the Odd Squad realise two dastardly villains are set to win Villain of the Year, they attempt to help a less frightening foe to victory.

videos.title: Planes, Trains and Oddmobiles
videos.overview: When he's unable to use the tube system, Onom has to use different types of transport to get 15 creature eggs to Orli and Ozzie before it’s too late.

videos.title: Part of the Furniture
videos.overview: Orli takes on too many jobs. She must juggle questioning a villain, changing the watermelon, and her commitments to various Odd Squad societies on the same day.

videos.title: The Odd Ness Monster
videos.overview: Orwell and Onom must protect the world against Odd Squad’s greatest secret: a giant monster that sleeps in the basement and will wake up at some point this year.

videos.title: Oddtober the Thirteenth
videos.overview: When some villains are invited into HQ for the annual Oddtober the 13th holiday, Orli and Ozzie find they’re a tough bunch to please.

videos.title: Agent Overhill's Last Day
videos.overview: It’s the legendary Agent Overhill’s last day at Odd Squad, and their mysterious nemesis is still causing oddness. Can Orwell help Overhill finally catch Villain X?

videos.title: The Other Ozzie
videos.overview: Orli and a different Ozzie from a movie star dimension need to stop a villain who’s making the town go purple one person at a time.

videos.title: Three is the Oddest Number
videos.overview: Kid villains The Terrible Three plot to steal three shapes from Odd Squad gadgets in the next phase of their plan to stop Odd Squad for good.

videos.title: Should Odd Acquaintance Be Forgotten, Part 1
videos.overview: When villains break into Odd Squad HQ, the agents must figure out where they're heading before they unleash oddness everywhere.

videos.title: Should Odd Acquaintance Be Forgotten, Part 2
videos.overview: With oddness unleashed in HQ and across town, Ozzie and Orli must find enough agents to help shut the containment units.

videos.title: Blast from the Past, Part 1
videos.overview: Ozzie and Orli must stop the villainous Knights of the Square Table from turning things to stone.

videos.title: Blast from the Past, Part 2
videos.overview: Ozzie and Orli travel back in time and make their way through a medieval castle to save the Odd Squad.

videos.title: The Triangle Café
videos.overview: Ozzie and Orli go on a mission to catch the villain who is ruining the Triangle Sisters’ café.

videos.title: Captain O's Birthday
videos.overview: Opie must collect enough money to pay for Captain O’s ten-layer birthday cake.

videos.title: Bring a Grown-Up to Work Day
videos.overview: Orli and Ozzie must find two grown-ups who get lost in HQ’s most dangerous areas.

videos.title: Nice Day for an Odd Wedding
videos.overview: The Odd Squad go undercover at a villain wedding to stop the guests from creating mass oddness.

videos.title: The Good, the Great, and the Hungry
videos.overview: Omni and Onom must track down a mysterious creature that has a very peculiar habit.

videos.title: The Rookie Run
videos.overview: Orli has to help new recruit Osric complete his training, but his fear of certain numbers becomes a big problem.

videos.title: A Town Called Trifle
videos.overview: On the town’s 100th year anniversary party, Ozzie and Onom must stop Tracey Trifler from covering the town in trifle.

videos.title: I Am Oddius
videos.overview: On their first case together, Osric and Omni try to stop a Roman gladiator from causing ancient oddness.

videos.title: The Night Mayor
videos.overview: Omni and Osric are desperate to get off the night shift and go to a party, but first they have to stop a mysterious villain.

videos.title: The Big Stink
videos.overview: Orwell and Okra must stop a flying machine from stinking up Odd Squad’s favourite places.

videos.title: Captain Cowboy
videos.overview: When Captain O turns into a cursed cowboy, Omni and Ook must find a way to remove the curse before she causes complete chaos around HQ.

videos.title: The Time the Help Department Needed Help
videos.overview: Onom must rescue Opie from a locked room before HQ completely falls apart.

videos.title: Ten Against One
videos.overview: Ozzie goes on a solo mission to work out which villain is causing oddness along the canal.

videos.title: Old Squad
videos.overview: Two adults calling themselves Old Squad are determined to help Odd Squad find the villain who has stolen pieces of the Mayor’s portrait.

videos.title: The Other Orly
videos.overview: Captain O decides to partner Orli with someone entirely unexpected.

videos.title: Train of Fools
videos.overview: Omni and Osric must catch a villain before the steam train they are on is thrown into another dimension.

videos.title: Being Onom
videos.overview: Orwell and Omni must locate Onom before a cute creature destroys HQ.

videos.title: Stop and Smell the Roses
videos.overview: Odd Squad help Monsieur Rapide get his speedy goggles back from his villain partner.

videos.title: Oddumentary
videos.overview: On the town’s football derby day, Osric tries to solve a case while being followed by a documentary crew.

videos.title: I Love it When a Plan Barely Comes Together
videos.overview: Techie Tallulah heads to Niagara Falls on a mission that will get Orli out of Precinct 97531 so she can carry out her evil plan.

videos.title: Cake Day, Part 1
videos.overview: Ozzie and Orli travel to the future with the hope of saving Odd Squad.

videos.title: Cake Day, Part 2
videos.overview: With a villain in HQ, Ozzie and Orli must think outside the box in order to save Odd Squad forever.
